name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Back: the right wing now follows official Charizard's back sprite. As in Charizard's, the far wing is seen nearly edge-on: it rises from behind the top of the back, passes behind the head and its tip stands up just behind the horn. Its fingers hang behind the head. Before, it spread wide out to the right. Nothing else changed.

note: Twenty-first look. Delta Charizard: the back's right wing placed as official Charizard's is.
